notes: Scope is wider than Director: every LTX 2.3 AV path through ComfyUI on this Mac returns silent audio. The working local audio path is the MLX eros lane, a different runtime.
LTX Director is fully usable today through the rental lane, which already stocks both weights in R2. CUDA was also 4-5x faster: 42s vs 170-210s for the same 73-frame control.
